digest.component_or_area: read CLI surfaces (show/list/search/ready) under sync contention
propositions: read CLI surfaces (show, list, search, ready) can return exit 0 with empty/truncated stdout when reconverge lock times out under concurrent write storms, causing output parsing failures
all read surfaces share the same reconverge path through ensure_fresh and must be tested generically under burst-write contention to prevent silent regressions
the ed2b fix (_RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT = 2s) prevents stalling but requires property testing across all read surfaces with throttle marker cleared per invocation
valid JSON empty output ([] for list/array surfaces) must be distinguished from truncated-empty stdout; exit 0 with parseable JSON shape is the invariant
sync throttle (/tmp/.ticket-sync-<md5(tracker)>) must be cleared before each parameterized read invocation so every surface exercises the reconverge path rather than short-circuiting to snapshot
